name: Enterprise Audit and Assurance
constraints: WM-ECO-035 owns engagement mandate, intended users, independence, assurance level and issuance authority; WM-ACT-033 owns execution, observations, evidence appraisal and findings after dual-root adjudication.
Audit Finding reuses WM-ACT-033 and aligns its assertion shape to WM-KNW-007 without duplicate identity.
Assurance Opinion is a sealed engagement-scoped statement and never general compliance status.
Corrective Action profiles WM-ACT-006 while management response remains a separate stated position.
Finding, issue, risk and task retain separate identity and explicit attributed links.
Finding closure requires independent retest against stated criteria; task completion closes only the task.
